# Coeficientes sísmicos basados en desempeño {#sec-coefficients}

## Resumen ejecutivo {#sec-coef_summary}

{{< include /_chapters/coefficients.summary.es.md >}}

```{r}
#| echo: false
#| results: asis
for (i in seq_len(nrow(SiteTable))) {
  .knitReportBlock(
    path = "/_summary/coefficients.results.es.qmd",
    stem = "coefficients-summary",
    sites = SiteTable,
    i = i,
    vars = list(ID.target = ID.gmdp),
    root = root,
    heading = SiteTable$label[[i]],
    level = 3L,
    anchor = "sec-coef-summary-site",
    context = "resumen ejecutivo de coeficientes Newmark"
  )
}
rm(i)
```
